## Summary

Successfully merged user data from three sources with priority-based conflict resolution:

**Output files created:**
- `/app/merged_users.parquet` - 4 unique users with unified schema
- `/app/conflicts.json` - 3 conflicts detected and resolved

**Results:**
- **Total unique users:** 4 (101, 102, 103, 104)
- **Conflicts resolved:** 3 (all for user_id 101)
  - name: "John D." vs "John Doe" → selected "John Doe" (source_a)
  - email: john@a.com vs john@b.com vs john@c.com → selected john@a.com (source_a)
  - created_date: 2024-01-15 vs 2024-01-10 vs 2024-01-20 → selected 2024-01-15 (source_a)

**Field mappings applied:**
- id/user_id/userId → user_id (integer)
- full_name/name/userName → name (string)
- email/email_address → email (string)
- registration_date/created_at/joined → created_date (YYYY-MM-DD format)
- status/is_active/active → status (normalized to "active"/"inactive")

**Priority order enforced:** source_a > source_b > source_c

All data types are correct, dates are in YYYY-MM-DD format, and the conflict report accurately tracks all discrepancies with the selected values based on source priority.
